{{Quote|Patience truly is a ''virtue''&hellip; especially in the Engineer Battalion!|Clone Sergeant Gaffa|<ref name="Repel" />}}
The '''Combat Engineer Battalion''', also called the '''Combat Engineers Battalion''' or just the '''Engineer Battalion''', was a [[Battalion/Legends|battalion]] of [[clone engineer]]s. The unit was part of the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]]'s [[38th Armored Division]]. Stationed on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]] and serving under the command of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]], the [[Trooper/Legends|troops]] of the battalion were sent where needed to act as armored ground support for heavy [[Artillery/Legends|artillery]] units to work on machinery such as [[Tank/Legends|tanks]] and [[Turbolaser/Legends|turbolasers]]. The battalion was used by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], which [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|began]] in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]].

By [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]], a contingent of [[Engineer/Legends|engineers]] from the Combat Engineer Battalion led by [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], [[Jedi Commander/Legends|Jedi Commander]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]], and [[Clone Sergeant/Legends|Clone Sergeant]] [[Gaffa]] took part in a [[Skirmish aboard the Twilight|skirmish]] aboard the [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] [[Twilight/Legends|''Twilight'']], during which they took parts from an inoperable [[A5-RX battle tank|battle tank]] and created a [[Missile/Legends|missile]] firing [[A5-RX Spread-Missile Battle Platform|battle platform]] to win the fight. The Combat Engineer Battalion's service would continue to the [[Mission to Mustafar/Legends|end]] of the war in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], when the unit was issued [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]] by [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]], marking all [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] as [[Treason/Legends|traitors]] to the Republic.

==Description==
{{Quote|Never say never, Ahsoka &mdash; Especially where clone engineers are concerned.|Obi-Wan Kenobi on the Engineer Battalion|<ref name="Repel" />}}
[[File:CloneCombatEngineer-TheSagaCollection.jpg|thumb|left|200px|A combat engineer clone trooper]]
The Combat Engineer Battalion was a [[Division/Legends|subdivision]] of the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic's]] [[38th Armored Division]],<ref name="Saga" /> a widely traveled ground assault unit.<ref name="CSWE-38th">{{CSWECite|III|206|38th Armored Division}}</ref> Led by<ref name="Saga" /> the [[Yoda's species/Legends|alien]]<ref name="RotS">{{Film|III}}</ref> [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]], the [[Clone engineer|clone combat engineers]] that made up the [[Battalion/Legends|battalion's]] forces<ref name="Saga" /> were specially trained<ref name="DVD">{{HasbroCite|set=Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith (toy line)|pack=Clone Troopers (Commemorative Episode III DVD Collection)|altlink=https://www.rebelscum.com/rots05dvdsetColl3.asp}}</ref> to work with large war machines, which included the [[HAVw A6 Juggernaut/Legends|HAVw A6 Juggernaut]] [[Tank/Legends|tank]] and the [[Self-Propelled Heavy Artillery/Legends|Self-Propelled Heavy Artillery]] [[Turbolaser/Legends|turbolaser]], and as such were assigned to heavy [[Artillery/Legends|artillery]] units and sent anywhere ground support was needed.<ref name="Saga" />

The [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] of the Combat Engineer Battalion wore [[Color/Legends|white]] [[Phase II clone trooper armor/Legends|Phase II clone trooper armor]] with chest markings and [[Helmet/Legends|helmets]] with a painted dome that left two white lines going across the top. The markings on the chest featured a central line that increased in width as it extended upward, with two lines on both sides curving away from the center. Two lines also extended from the chest markings down to the upper [[Limb/Legends|legs]] where they stopped. These markings were worn in either a brown or a dull yellow color.<ref name="Saga" /> Some [[Cloning/Legends|clones]] of the Engineer Battalion only had markings on their helmets, where the brow and central fin were colored yellow. The clone [[Engineer/Legends|engineers]] utilized [[F-187 fusioncutter]]s to make repairs and modifications to the equipment they worked on.<ref name="Repel" /> They also came equipped with [[DC-15S/Legends|DC-15 blasters]] and [[DC-15A blaster rifle/Legends|DC-15A blaster rifles]] for use during combat.<ref name="DVD" />

==History==
{{Quote|I may have a ''solution'', General.''"<br />"''I have complete faith in your ''resolve'' Sergeant Gaffa, but&hellip; your ''tank'' isn't operational and your men are ''unarmed''.''"<br />"''Who needs a ''blaster'' when you've got an ''F-187 cutting tool''? Buy us some breathing space, sir, and we'll ''earn'' that faith!|Gaffa and Obi-Wan Kenobi|<ref name="Repel" />}}
[[File:38thArmoredDivision-RepelAllBoarders.jpg|thumb|right|300px|Combat Engineers, including Sergeant Gaffa, at work]]
The Combat Engineers Battalion<ref name="Threat">''[[Threats of the Galaxy]]''</ref> was made up of clone [[Trooper/Legends|trooper]] engineers<ref name="Saga" /> that were created on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]] by the [[Kaminoan/Legends|Kaminoans]] to serve the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. The battalion of troopers were used by the Republic to combat the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]],<ref name="CloneDatabank">{{DB|organization|clonetroopers|clone troopers}}</ref> which [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|began]] in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]].<ref name="TNEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> The battalion was placed under the command of Jedi Master Yoda and stationed on<ref name="Saga" /> the [[Jungle/Legends|jungle]] planet<ref name="Kashyyyk">{{DB|location|kashyyyk|Kashyyyk}}</ref> [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]]<ref name="Saga" /> in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim Territories]].<ref name="Kashyyyk" />

By [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]],<ref name="RepelDate">{{TCWComicCite|6.18|Repel All Boarders!}} depicts [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] as an active member of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]]. Since the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' [[The Clone Wars: Season Five|season five]] episode "The Wrong Jedi" shows Tano leaving the Order, the events of the comic must take place no later than when the episode takes place, which [[The Official Star Wars Fact File Part 42|''The Official Star Wars Fact File Part'' 42]] {{C|20 BBY 51-54: Jedi Temple bombing}} dates the events of to [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]].</ref> members of the Engineer Battalion, along with an inoperable [[A5-RX battle tank|battle tank]] they planned to salvage, were present on the [[G9 Rigger-class light freighter/Legends|G9 Rigger freighter]] [[Twilight/Legends|''Twilight'']] under the leadership of the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Togruta/Legends|Togruta]] [[Jedi Commander/Legends|Jedi Commander]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]]. Part of a [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]], an engagement against Separatist [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] resulted in Republic forces retreating, which left the ''Twilight'' to be pursued by [[Vulture-class starfighter/Legends|''Vulture''-class starfighters]]. The battle resulted in six of the battalion's engineers on life support and four more with long-term injuries. With the damage the ''Twilight'' sustained shutting down the [[Starship/Legends|ship's]] [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]] and [[Engine/Legends|engines]], [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-series battle droids]] were able to board the [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]]. During the ensuing [[Skirmish aboard the Twilight|skirmish]], [[Gaffa]], a [[Clone Sergeant/Legends|Clone Sergeant]] of the Combat Engineer Battalion, devised a plan. While their [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Commander/Legends|commanders]] fended off the onslaught of battle [[Droid/Legends|droids]], Gaffa and the rest of the able-bodied troops reconfigured parts of the inoperable tank into what Gaffa dubbed as the [[A5-RX Spread-Missile Battle Platform]]. The clones then proceeded to fire a volley of [[Missile/Legends|missiles]], blasting a hole into the side of the ''Twilight'', causing the droids to be jettisoned into [[Realspace/Legends|space]]. Through the hole they made, the clones then shot more missiles, destroying the vulture droids outside and allowing the ''Twilight'' to escape.<ref name="Repel" /> 

At the war's [[Mission to Mustafar/Legends|end]] in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]],<ref name="TNEC" /> the clones of the Combat Engineer Battalion were issued [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]],<ref name="DVD" /> which branded all Jedi as [[Treason/Legends|traitors]] to the Republic, by [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]],<ref name="RotS" /> to which the Engineer Battalion turned against their Jedi leaders. The actions of the battalion, along with the other clones of the Grand Army, ushered in the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|First Galactic Empire]]<ref name="DVD" /> with Palpatine as the [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Galactic Emperor]].<ref name="RotS" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Clones_variations_concept_rots.png|thumb|right|250px|Concept art featuring various clone commander designs, including what would become the Engineer Battalion's design]]
First pictured in ''[[The Making of Star Wars Revenge of the Sith]]'',<ref name="Making">''[[The Making of Star Wars Revenge of the Sith]]''</ref> published on [[April 2]], [[2005]],<ref name="Cargo">{{SWArchive|url=episode-iii/release/publishing/news20040719.html|text=Del Rey Goes Behind the Scenes of Episode III}}</ref> the armor design that would eventually become that of the Combat Engineer Battalion was created by concept artist [[Alex Jaeger]], originally meant to be a [[Clone Commander/Legends|clone commander]] variation for the film [[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith'']],<ref name="Making" /> released on [[May 19]], 2005.<ref name="Year by Year">''[[Star Wars Year By Year: A Visual History, Updated and Expanded Edition]]''</ref> The art depicted the clone commander carrying a DC-15A blaster rifle and wearing armor with brown markings and a chest design that resembled a [[Wikipedia:Fleur-de-lis|fleur-de-lis]].<ref name="Making" /> Going unused in the film,<ref name="RotS" /> the design was eventually repurposed for the Combat Engineer Battalion, being identified in [[Hasbro]]'s ''[[Star Wars: The Saga Collection]]'' pack number sixty-eight labeled "Combat Engineer Clone Trooper."<ref name="Saga" /> The pack was released in [[2007]],<ref name="Action Release">''[[Star Wars: The Ultimate Action Figure Collection]]''</ref> and gave the name "Combat Engineer Battalion."<ref name="Saga" /> Released in [[2008]],<ref name="Threat Release">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/article/totg1|text=''Threats of the Galaxy'' Preview 1}}</ref> the [[roleplaying game]] sourcebook ''[[Threats of the Galaxy]]'' gave the slightly different name of the "Combat Engineers Battalion," where the only difference is the pluralization of the word engineer.<ref name="Threat" /> The battalion would finally make its debut appearance in the "[[Repel All Boarders!]]" comic that featured in the [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars Comic 6.18|eighteenth issue of the sixth volume]] of the [[Star Wars Comic|''Star Wars'' Comic]] magazines.<ref name="Repel" /> Released on [[March 10]], [[2011]],<ref name="Repel Release">{{SWArchive|url=vault/books/whatsnewmar14/index.html|text=What's New This Week: ''Insider'' #124, ''Clone Wars Comic'' #6.18, & ''Galaxy'' #6}}</ref> the comic was written by [[Robin Etherington]] and the Engineer Battalion's depiction was created by artist [[Andres Ponce]]. The comic also gave the unit the shortened name of "Engineer Battalion."<ref name="Repel" />
